title: iOS 27 now seeding, here are all the iPhones getting it
description: Apple is rolling out iOS 27 to users today. This update brings a host of improvements, including refinements to Liquid Glass, up to 30% faster app load times, revamped Spotlight, Photos, and Mail search functionality, and Apple’s revamped Siri AI. Siri AI is rolling out in Beta with English-only support and will not be available initially in the EU. Support for French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, and Spanish is coming in October. title: iQOO 16 launch date and color options revealed
description: Last week, iQOO offered a glimpse at the redesigned rear camera module of its upcoming iQOO 16. The company later confirmed that the phone will use Samsung’s new M16 display panel with a 165Hz refresh rate and 2K resolution. Now, iQOO has revealed the handset’s launch date and color options. The iQOO 16 will launch in China on September 29 and will go on sale on the same day, the company confirmed in a post on Weibo. Pre-orders for the handset are already live through iQOO’s online store in China. In a separate post, iQOO also revealed the color options for the upcoming phone....

title: Samsung quietly makes the Galaxy A08 official with a bigger battery
description: A few days ago, the Samsung Galaxy A08 was listed by an online retailer in the UAE, and now the Korean company has decided to make it official, with no fanfare, no official press release, nothing like that. Samsung has just simply added the Galaxy A08 to its website in both Serbia and Bosnia and Herzegovina. The device comes with a 6.7-inch PLS LCD screen with 720x1600 resolution, a 50MP rear camera with f/1.8 aperture, a 2MP f/2.4 auxiliary rear camera, an 8MP front camera, and a 6,000 mAh battery. description: Last week Oppo started teasing the upcoming F35 series in India, confirming that it's going to be launching soon. Today, a new leak purports to show us both devices in some leaked renders. We are assuming that the F35 Pro is on top here, as that would neatly fit with previous rumors claiming it would be a rebranded A7 Pro Max, which has the exact same design. Speaking of design, the F35 looks a lot like the A7 Pro. title: Honor Play11 gets official with an 8,300 mAh battery and the Snapdragon 4 Gen 4 SoC
description: Honor's increasingly vast Play11 family has added a new member today, namely the 'vanilla' Honor Play11. This device comes with a 6.872-inch LCD screen with 720x1592 resolution, a 120Hz refresh rate, and 1,020-nit peak brightness. On the rear there's a 50MP camera with f/1.8 aperture, while on the front there’s a 5MP selfie shooter. The handset is powered by the Snapdragon 4 Gen 4 SoC, paired with 6/8GB of RAM and 128/256GB of storage. title: Qualcomm's Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 may be made in part by Samsung
description: According to a new report from Korea today, Qualcomm is still in talks with Samsung about the latter joining TSMC in making the former's upcoming flagship Snapdragon chips. Qualcomm is expected to announce the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 and the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro later this month, and a lot of prior rumors have suggested that TSMC will be the only foundry making them. However, today's new report claims Qualcomm is still open to a dual-source setup with TSMC and Samsung. title: iPhone Duo may become an entire product line, new rumor claims
description: For a long time the first foldable iPhone was rumored to be called iPhone Ultra, but Apple actually went with iPhone Duo as you may know. If you were wondering why, Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman has an intriguing theory. According to him, Apple is planning multiple foldable iPhones for the future - a bigger iPhone Duo Max, a smaller iPhone Duo mini, and even an entry-level iPhone Duo SE. These suffixes work much better with the Duo name than they would have with Ultra - just imagine an iPhone Ultra mini, or an iPhone Ultra Max. It's all a bit much. description: Less than two weeks after the first One UI 9 beta for the Galaxy S24 series, Samsung is rolling out a second beta – and it brings some of the headlining features from the Galaxy Z8 foldables and the Galaxy S26 flagships. description: The vivo X500 series is getting official on September 21, and ahead of that today a new video has been outed, starring the 'vanilla' X500. The new design is clearly visible throughout, with a circular camera island in the left part of a bigger rectangular plateau, because every Chinese brand seemingly has to do the plateau now that Apple's all-in with it. The X500 will be offered in black, gray, pink, and a gradient colorway. It will have a 50MP main camera using Sony's Lytia 828 1/1.28" type sensor. description: According to industry sources, cited by ET News, Samsung is preparing to equip the upcoming Galaxy S27 lineup, or more specifically the S27 Pro and the S27 Ultra, with its next-generation M16 OLED panel. The panel will deliver higher brightness performance, improved energy efficiency, longer lifespan and more accurate color reproduction. Interestingly enough, the M16 OLED won't debut with the Galaxy S27 series. Samsung and iQOO have both confirmed during an event in China that the M16 OLED will be used by the upcoming iQOO 16. title: Honor Robot Phone gets bend tested and disassembled on video
description: Honor launched the Robot Phone in China in August, and today it's reached Zack from the JerryRigEverything YouTube channel. Unsurprisingly, he's subjected it to his usual battery of "durability tests", and then disassembled it - all in the video below, so grab some popcorn and enjoy the ride. The Honor Robot Phone's gimbal camera is definitely very cool as a concept, but it turns out it's actually quite hot to the touch. title: The Galaxy S26 FE comes to India, here's how much it costs
description: Samsung’s latest FE series phone, the Galaxy S26 FE, has finally landed in India after its global launch last month. The phone will be available for purchase in the country starting September 18. The Samsung Galaxy S26 FE has been launched in India at INR 79,999 for the 8GB/256GB configuration. It will be available in Blueberry, Graphite, and Pistachio colorways. It comes equipped with an Exynos 2500 chipset and a 6.7-inch AMOLED display, which offers a Full-HD+ resolution, up to 1,900 nits of peak brightness, and 120Hz refresh rate. title: No, Samsung isn't changing the telephoto camera on the Galaxy S27 Ultra, says Ice Universe
description: A few weeks ago, we heard a rumor that Samsung will replace the long telephoto camera on the Galaxy S27 Ultra. That is not happening, says Ice Universe. The S27 Ultra will keep the 5x 1/2.52” telephoto module of the S26 Ultra. The rumor was claiming that Samsung will replace it with a new module with a shorter lens (4x) and a larger sensor (1/1.9”). This is “100% false,” says Ice. The leakster didn’t say anything about the rumor that Samsung will remove the 3x 10MP tele module, so that’s likely going away. description: Samsung Display detailed its latest and brightest smartphone LTPO OLED panel today, which will soon make its way to the iQOO 16. It uses Samsung’s M16 luminescent material, which is also present on the iPhone 18 Pro series and iPhone Duo. But the one that is set to make its debut on the iQOO 16 is advertised to reach an industry-topping 10,000 nits peak local brightness. That’s the maximum brightness level that the panel can achieve in a small isolated area on the screen for short bursts of time (seconds to a few minutes). description: Last week, Honor teased the design of the Magic9 Pro Max.
